sources.title: Qwen-Image-Edit-F2P: Image-to-Image model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: This model is better if you need plug-and-play workflow compatibility; use Qwen-Image-Edit-F2P if you require explicit face-to-portrait semantics and have flexibility in implementation. Qwen3-8B-FP8 by Qwen is a text generation model, not an image model, and serves entirely different use cases (language understanding and generation).

sources.snippet: AI Arena To comprehensively evaluate the general image generation capabilities of Qwen-Image and objectively compare it with state-of-the-art closed-source APIs, we introduce AI Arena, an open benchmarking platform built on the Elo rating system. AI Arena provides a fair, transparent, and dynamic environment for model evaluation.
